quote: We conduct a systematic study of social stereotypes in contextualized English masked LMs...
We assess two previously proposed word association tests and also propose a new measurement: the sensitivity test (SeT) (§3).

We measure word association for social bias in language models, not using LLMs as judges after generation.
We recruit participants from Prolific ... to rate 5 social groups on 16 pairs of traits.
